proposal.hypothesis: Precomputing the y- and z-neighbor line pointers once per row should reduce repeated address-offset work in the inner x loop while retaining contiguous accesses for compiler vectorization. A guarded, unhinted OpenMP SIMD directive is supported by earlier valid candidates in this build; starting all pointers at x0 avoids any false alignment claim. Whether this distinct pointer-hoisted formulation improves on the existing SIMD candidates remains to be measured.

retained: Keep the single-timestep sweep, arithmetic grouping, bounds, buffer parity, and interface unchanged.
Precompute pointers for each y- and z-neighbor line once per x row, then traverse the contiguous interior x range with a zero-based index.
Guard an unhinted OpenMP SIMD directive for OpenMP 4.0 or later; leave the same loop available for compiler vectorization without the directive.
Base every line at x0 and make no alignment assertion, ISA assumption, compiler-flag change, threading change, or spatial/temporal blocking change.
